title: 交易纪律 | 我贴在屏幕边的五条规矩，今天原样分享
subTitle:
带情绪的日子里，人会忘掉所有道理，所以我把它写在纸上贴着：

一、开仓前先写止损位，写不出来就不开仓。
二、单笔亏损不超过本金的2%，雷打不动。
三、亏损的单不加仓，永远不摊平。
四、连错三笔，当天停手，只看不做。
五、盈利提现一部分，转出的是钱，留下的是心态。

就五条，没有一条是关于「怎么看行情」的。因为亏大钱的原因，从来
不是看错了行情，是执行变形了。共勉。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

translatedData.title: Trading Discipline | The five rules I keep beside my screen, shared exactly as written
translatedData.subTitle:
On emotional days, people forget every principle, so I wrote them down and stuck them up:

One: Write down your stop-loss level before entering a trade. If you can’t, don’t enter.
Two: Never risk more than 2% of your capital on a single trade. No exceptions.
Three: Never add to a losing position or average down.
Four: After three consecutive losing trades, stop for the day. Watch, but don’t trade.
Five: Withdraw some of your profits. The money goes out; the discipline stays.

That’s all five. Not one of them is about “how to read the market.” Because the reason people lose big money is never
that they read the market wrong—it’s that their execution fell apart. Let’s keep each other accountable.

title: 九月底2,807一路滑到1,653，ETH把利好全当背景板，现在到底谁在扛盘？
subTitle:
快五点了，趁着欧美盘交接前把软件切回日线，把 $ETH 缩小拉了一整屏出来看，盯着屏幕发了半天呆，心里只有一句话：这走势是真把多头磨得一点脾气都没了。

说实话，前阵子从九月下旬的 2,807.34 美元一路阴跌下来，中间每次反弹我都觉得是不是要筑底了，结果每次抄在半山腰的人回头一看，全成了阶梯上的燃料。刚过去的这五天更是把这种无力感演到了极致：11 月 20 号那根放量长阴直接砸到 1,581.47 美元，一天干出去 11.14 亿美元的成交；21 号早盘又往下狠踹一脚摸到 1,538.00 美元才拽出一根长下影收在 1,685.63 美元。当时群里多少人拍大腿喊着“双针探底成了”，结果 23 号那根冲到 1,845.07 美元的插针，当天晚上就原形毕露跌回 1,710.65 美元，把追突破的筹码直接挂在山顶吹风。

昨天又阴跌收在 1,680.11 美元，今天到现在 24 小时继续往下磨了 2.3% 左右，现价就在 1,653.71 美元附近晃悠，日内最低打到 1,633.11 美元，最高也就摸了下 1,708.16 美元，24 小时成交额 4.87 亿美元摆在全市场第二，但就是一点往上冲的干劲都没有。最扎心的是日线上的均线压制，七日线 MA7 现在就在 1,690.69 美元卡着脖子，至于 25 日线还远在 1,965.16 美元天上飘着。外头新闻这两天其实挺热闹，又是 CFTC 允许拿以太坊和稳定币充当特定储备金要求，又是 Bitmine 披露增持了 7,819 枚 ETH，按理说放以前早该借题发挥拉一根大阳线了，现在倒好，利好全当背景板，连 1,700 美元的门槛都迈不过去。

大嫂一虚，底下跟着混饭吃的生态币就更难看。翻了眼老牌 DeFi 龙头 $UNI ，这几天跟坐滑梯似的——17 号最高还能摸到 5.454 美元，21 号砸穿到 4.188 美元，23 号好不容易跟着大盘反抽了一口到 5.312 美元，今天直接又摔了超过 5.2% 跌到 4.557 美元，日内最低都踩到 4.512 美元了，24 小时成交 2,100 万美元。每次行情稍微有点风吹草动，这类高弹性标的跌起来比以太坊本体狠两倍，做波段的稍微贪个隔夜基本都要挨耳光。

不过今天刷了一圈主流币，唯独 $BNB 的盘面让我有点服气。大盘普遍绿得发慌，它现价还在 543.83 美元附近横着，24 小时只微跌了 1.19%，区间也就 537.4 到 554.53 美元，24 小时成交 4,690 万美元，硬生生挤进了全市场抗跌榜前排。回头看它 21 号最低也插到过 503.75 美元，23 号一度冲上 587.36 美元，这两天跟着大市回吐涨幅，却稳稳守在 540 美元一带没乱阵脚。手里要是分了仓对比着看，就能明显感觉到眼下资金只敢抱紧真正扛揍的筹码，弱势币一丁点接盘意愿都没有。

接下来的晚盘我也不打算猜底了，手痒的时候多看看 1,633 和 1,538 这两个前低位置能不能真的承接住，什么时候 $ETH 能放量重新站上 1,690 的七日线再说别的。行情磨人归磨人，本金留着比啥都强，以上纯属个人看盘碎碎念，非投资建议，自己拿捏好仓位。

translatedData.title: From $2,807 in late September to $1,653: ETH is treating every bullish catalyst as background noise. So who’s holding the line now?
translatedData.subTitle:
It’s nearly five. Before the European and U.S. sessions hand over, I switched the chart back to the daily timeframe, zoomed out $ETH  to fit the whole screen, and stared at it for ages. I could only think one thing: this price action has completely worn the bulls down.

Honestly, ever since the steady slide from $2,807.34 in late September, every bounce had me wondering if we were finally building a bottom. But every time, anyone who bought the dip halfway down looked back and realized they’d all become fuel for the next leg lower. The past five days took that feeling of helplessness to the extreme: the long, heavy-volume red candle on November 20 sent the price crashing to $1,581.47, with $1.114 billion in trading volume that day. Early on the 21st, it took another brutal leg down, touching $1,538.00 before a long lower wick pulled it back up to close at $1,685.63. So many people in the group were slapping their thighs and shouting, “That double-bottom is in!” But then came the spike to $1,845.07 on the 23rd, only for the price to show its true colors that very night and fall back to $1,710.65, leaving breakout buyers stranded at the top with the wind whistling past them.

Everyone wants to double their money overnight, but the people who truly hold on to their wealth in this market are the ones who “get rich slowly.”
Let’s do the math: earning just 1% a day over 250 trading days in a year gives you 12 times your money; a steady 10% a month
adds up to 30 times your money over three years. It doesn’t sound thrilling, but it has one remarkable advantage—it doesn’t depend on luck.

Doubling your money depends on market conditions; compounding depends on discipline. Market opportunities come to those who wait; discipline is up to you. Don’t make your goal
“Double my money this week.” Make it “no major mistakes this week” instead. The money from the former is given by the market,
while the ability behind the latter is yours. The market is open every day, but only those who preserve their capital are qualified to keep playing.

Nasdaq-listed company BTCS sold 27,300 ETH, Aave reduced its debt by $43.8 million

BTCS, traded on Nasdaq, has cashed out a significant portion of its Ethereum holdings. In a filing with the US Securities and Exchange Commission, the company announced it generated $43.8 million from the sale of approximately 27,300 $ETH.

All of the proceeds were used to repay the debt on the decentralized lending protocol Aave. Following the transaction, the remaining debt on Aave was reduced to approximately $10.5 million.

According to the company’s statement, on the day of the sale, $ETH fell approximately 12 percent from its intraday high to around $1,561. BTCS reported that after the debt repayment, the ratio of the loan amount to the collateral value was approximately 32 percent.
The company’s Imperium unit also temporarily closed its positions in liquidity pools due to market volatility. Management thus reduced both its debt amount and its highly volatile up-chain positions.

In a crypto-collateralized loan, even if the loan amount remains fixed, the dollar value of the collateral changes with the price. When eth loses value, the loan-to-collateral ratio increases. If the threshold set by the protocol is exceeded, a portion of the collateral may be liquidated.

BTCS’s sale reduced the amount of $ETH it held, while the debt repayment also eased the liquidation pressure on the remaining position. The financial impact of the transaction for the company depends on evaluating these two changes together.

BTCS reported that it holds approximately 24,245 ETH after the sale, and the total value of its digital assets, including cash, is approximately $61 million. This calculation is based on the ETH price as of November 22nd, and the company describes the figures as preliminary estimates. translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | What Does the Candle You FOMO Into Usually Look Like?
translatedData.subTitle:
The price shoots up in a big bullish candle, everyone in the group chat is yelling “Buy!”, and you impulsively chase in—only to end up buying at
the top. This plays out every day.

Take a good look at that big bullish candle that gets your heart racing: it’s the one that people who are already fully invested hope you’ll chase in and take off their hands
Chasing after a sharp, high-volume surge is essentially providing liquidity for those who bought earlier.

A simple but effective trick: when you feel like chasing, force yourself to wait for three candlesticks. If the pullback comes on lower volume and stabilizes,
you’ll get a better entry; if it drops straight back down, congratulations—you’ve saved yourself an expensive lesson. The market will always
give you a second chance, but it won’t give you a second bankroll.

If your risk management is poor, you’ll give back even the profits you’ve made.

Fidelity adds trading for three DeFi tokens | ETH remains near $1,640 | More access does not equal more on-chain buying

I see the long-term significance of expanded access, but I wouldn’t use it as a reason to chase ETH today. Binance Square is discussing #FidelityCryptoAddsAAVELINKAndUNITrading. Fidelity Crypto’s official help page now lists AAVE, LINK, and UNI as tradable assets alongside existing offerings such as BTC, ETH, and SOL; availability is still subject to state restrictions. The fact is that a retail platform has expanded its list of tradable assets—not that Fidelity has disclosed how many tokens it has bought, much less announced that trading volume on the Ethereum mainnet has risen in tandem.

The connection between this news and ETH is through the ecosystem, not a simple direct flow of funds. Aave lending, Uniswap trading, and Chainlink oracle services are all closely tied to the Ethereum application ecosystem. A crypto platform under a traditional brokerage choosing to offer these tokens shows that investors have access to a broader range of assets, from foundational assets to the application layer. But Fidelity customer orders are executed through its custodians and external liquidity providers, and not every trade on the platform necessarily corresponds to an on-chain Ethereum transaction. If users are simply rebalancing within the platform, trading volume cannot be directly converted into ETH gas consumption or spot demand for ETH. Conversely, if on-chain activity, stablecoin flows, and developer retention all improve in tandem later, that would provide more substantial validation of the ecosystem.

The market has not yet assigned a definite ETH premium to this “increase in access.” At the time of writing, Kraken ETH/USD was around $1,637.55, with a 24-hour opening reference of $1,677.71, a low of $1,631.13, and a high of $1,706.32; the price remains close to the session low. Farside’s November 24 table for U.S. spot ETH funds shows total net outflows of $64.1 million, including about $37.8 million in outflows from ETHA and about $25.8 million from ETHB, indicating that inflows on the traditional-products side have not yet strengthened in tandem. These fund subscription and redemption figures relate to different products from Fidelity’s new token trading and should not be conflated as a single flow of funds; nor can ETH’s decline simply be attributed to this listing.

I’ll be watching for two confirming conditions: whether Fidelity’s newly added tokens bring sustained, genuine demand, and whether ETH can reclaim $1,660 and hold above it. Around $1,630 corresponds to the session low; a break below that level would further confirm short-term weakness. If ETH rebounds to $1,675 but still finds no spot buying support, chasing the move would actually carry more risk.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t participate now; I’d only consider a directionally bullish, unleveraged spot trade. The entry trigger would be two consecutive 15-minute candles closing above $1,660, followed by a retest that holds between $1,650 and $1,660, with BTC also ceasing to make new lows and the first bout of sharp volatility after the PCE release having passed. Only if all conditions are met would I use 0.5% of my total capital. I’d sell half at $1,675 and close the remaining position near $1,705. After entry, I’d first reduce the position by half if ETH falls back below $1,640, and fully exit at a stop-loss if it drops below $1,628. If the price falls below $1,630 first, I’d cancel the plan outright. If the conditions aren’t triggered, there’s no trade—and no profit to review.

Sources: Fidelity Crypto’s official trading help page, Farside’s ETH fund table, Kraken ETH/USD market data, and the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis release schedule. #FidelityCryptoAddsAAVELINKAndUNITrading #ETH

富达新增三种DeFi代币交易｜ETH仍在1640美元附近｜入口扩张不等于链上买盘

我的态度是认可渠道扩张的长期意义，但今天不据此追买ETH。币安广场正在讨论#FidelityCryptoAddsAAVELINKAndUNITrading，富达Fidelity Crypto的官方帮助页现已把AAVE、LINK、UNI列入可买卖资产，与原有的BTC、ETH、SOL等并列；是否可用仍受所在州限制。这里的事实是零售平台扩充了可交易品种，不是富达披露已买入多少代币，更不是宣布以太坊主网交易量已经同步增长。

这条消息与ETH的联系在于生态，而不是简单的资金直达。Aave借贷、Uniswap交易以及Chainlink预言机服务都与以太坊应用体系密切相关；传统券商旗下加密入口愿意覆盖这些代币，说明投资者可接触的范围从基础资产扩至应用层。可富达的客户订单由其托管和外部流动性提供方执行，平台内每次买卖未必对应一笔以太坊链上交易。若用户只是平台内换仓，不能把成交额直接换算成ETH Gas消耗或ETH现货需求。反过来，若此后能看到链上活跃、稳定币流转和开发者留存同步改善，才有更扎实的生态验证。

市场当前没有为这个“入口增加”给出确定的ETH溢价。Kraken ETH/USD写稿时约1637.55美元，24小时开盘参考1677.71美元，低点1631.13、高点1706.32；价格仍靠近日内低位。Farside的11月24日美国现货ETH基金表列合计净流出6410万美元，其中ETHA约流出3780万美元、ETHB约流出2580万美元，说明传统产品一侧的资金还没有同步转强。这个基金申赎数据与富达新币种交易属于不同产品，不能混成同一笔资金；ETH下跌也不能简单归因于此次上币。

我会看两个验证条件：富达新增币种能否带来持续真实需求，以及ETH是否收回1660美元并守住。1630美元附近对应日内低点，失守后短线弱势将进一步确认；若反弹至1675美元却仍无现货承接，追涨风险反而增加。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与，方向只准备无杠杆现货试多。入场触发是ETH连续两根15分钟K线收在1660美元上方，回踩1650至1660守住，BTC同时停止破低，且PCE公布后第一轮急剧波动结束；全部满足后使用总资金0.5%。到1675美元减半，到1705美元附近清掉余仓；入场后收回1640美元下方先减半，跌破1628美元全部止损平仓。若价格先失守1630，直接取消计划。条件未触发就没有成交，更没有利润可复盘。

If ETH drops from $1,638 to $1,000, the first things to come under pressure won’t be faith, but collateral values, leveraged positions, and trading depth. The fear index is only at 13, but a steep drop doesn’t mean its technological value has fallen to zero.

The Ethereum Foundation has doubled the size of its protocol security team and is prioritizing cryptographic upgrades, because the threat AI poses to current mathematical assumptions is more urgent than quantum computing.

It’s like changing the locks on a vault. In practice, wallets, nodes, DeFi protocols, and trading platforms will all have to bear the costs of upgrades, compatibility, and audits. Those who use ETH as collateral or a settlement asset will also price in a security risk discount. Does the business logic hold up? Yes. Only when security is trustworthy will stablecoins, DeFi, and institutional-grade applications dare to put ETH at their core.

So I wouldn’t automatically call it cheap just because it’s plunged. I’d look at whether the upgrade roadmap can be carried out, whether the ecosystem can migrate in sync, and whether real-world usage is holding up. Remember this: ETH’s greatest value isn’t its code, but its ability to sustain consensus over time.

If you were in charge of the cryptographic migration, what would be harder: maintaining compatibility with legacy accounts, or persuading nodes around the world to upgrade together? What do you make of this move?

title: BNB 盘面解读：看似有机会，实则空头占优，500 美元大关要来了？
subTitle:
大盘持续走弱的环境下，$BNB 
{future}(BNBUSDT)
 也没能独善其身。#BTC  跌破 6 万、ETH 失守 2000 美元，带动整个加密市场抛压扩散，BNB 的交易格局同样偏空。
就在 11 月 23 日，市场剧烈震荡，大量空头集中爆仓，光是空单清算金额就达到 5.2 亿美元。但一波短暂的逼空反弹，并没有扭转 BNB 的大趋势，没能站稳 600 美元之后，空头再度掌握主动权。
周线视角：500 美元是生死支撑
拉长周线来看，BNB 在 2025 年底的熊市行情里，最低摸到 500 美元附近，上一次靠近这个价位还是 2025 年初。虽然中途曾经走出过内部看涨结构突破，但是上方遗留的供应区压制很强。

早在今年 1-2 月，BNB 从 933 美元一路下跌到 570 美元，这段下跌留下的价格失衡区域，就像一块大石头压在上方，每次反弹到这里都容易被砸下来。
当前 BNB 已经回调至 537 美元附近，距离 500 美元支撑越来越近。这里有一个关键点：只要周线收盘价不跌破 500 美元，BNB 长期波动结构还保留一丝看涨预期；一旦有效跌破，趋势会彻底走坏。
日线 + 小时图：空头目标指向 503.75 美元
切换到日线图，空头信号更加清晰。前期 551.45–576.39 美元的公允价值缺口，已经在周一的剧烈波动中被回补。而多次冲击 600 美元失败，直接巩固了空头优势，下一个目标位看向 503.75 美元。途中 530 美元是短期局部支撑，可能会短暂拖住下跌节奏，形成小幅反弹，但大概率只是下跌途中的喘息。

再看小时级别，盘面同样同步走弱。价格收在 550.82 美元下方，确认结构转向空头。之前反弹测试 555 美元供应区失败回落，进一步加大下行压力。想要打破这个看跌思路，需要小时线强势站上 562.19 美元，否则下跌目标依旧有效。
行情总结和交易思路
简单一句话概括：BNB 现在属于大趋势偏弱，靠近关键支撑的博弈阶段。几次冲击 600 美元关口失败，已经说明多头力量不足，熊市主导的格局没有改变。短期先看 530 美元能不能扛住，扛不住就会直奔 503 美元、500 美元这个核心支撑。

当然支撑位不代表一定会守住，大盘联动风险很高。如果 BTC、#ETH  继续放量下杀，BNB 很容易跟着破位。如果是短线玩家，不要着急抄底；想要博弈反弹，需要等价格重新站稳 562 美元以上，再观察买盘力度。提醒一下，加密市场波动极大，支撑位也存在直接击穿的可能，杠杆仓位一定要严格控制，不要重仓去赌支撑！

title: 交易心理 | 扛单的时候，你的大脑在骗你
subTitle:
浮亏50%的人在看什么？在看「历史最高价」，心里念叨：回到我的成本，
我就走。注意，这个想法里全是执念，没有逻辑。市场不知道你的成本价，
它只认当下的供需。

扛起单之后，你会自动收集利好、屏蔽利空，这叫确认偏误。你会觉得
「这次不一样」，这五个字，历史上烧掉的钱比任何黑客都多。

解药其实很简单，但很难做到：开仓前就写好「什么情况下这笔单的逻辑
失效」，到点执行，不看心情。把决策从持有中剥离出来，你才能看清
盘面在说什么，而不是你想听什么。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Your Brain Is Lying to You When You’re Stuck Holding a Losing Trade
translatedData.subTitle:
What does someone down 50% look at? The “all-time high,” thinking to themselves: “If it just gets back to my entry price,
I’ll get out.” Be careful: this thought is all attachment, with no logic behind it. The market doesn’t know your entry price;
it only responds to supply and demand in the present.

Once you’re stuck holding a losing position, you automatically seek out good news and tune out bad news. This is called confirmation bias. You start thinking,
“This time is different.” Those five words have cost more money throughout history than any hacker ever has.

The antidote is actually simple, but hard to put into practice: before opening a position, write down “under what circumstances the logic behind this trade
fails,” then act when that point is reached, regardless of how you feel. Separate your decision-making from holding the position, and you’ll be able to see clearly

title: 交易心理 | 止损不是认错，是给下一笔机会买的门票
subTitle:

过不去。换个角度想：止损是你提前买好的保险，保费就是那一小笔亏损。
职业玩家和赌徒的区别，不是谁更准，而是谁允许自己错。

我见过最稳的交易者，错起来比谁都干脆。因为他知道：这一笔的对错
不重要，一百笔下来的期望值才重要。下一次止损手抖的时候，对自己

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | A stop-loss isn’t admitting you’re wrong—it’s the price of admission for your next opportunity
translatedData.subTitle:
Many people struggle to cut their losses because they treat a stop-loss as proof that “I was wrong.” Their pride
gets in the way. Look at it differently: a stop-loss is insurance you bought in advance, and the premium is that small loss.
The difference between professional traders and gamblers isn’t who’s more often right, but who allows themselves to be wrong.

The most disciplined traders I’ve ever met are quicker than anyone to admit when they’re wrong. Because they know: whether this trade is right or wrong
doesn’t matter. What matters is the expected value over a hundred trades. The next time your hand hesitates when it’s time to cut a loss, tell yourself
this is the price of admission, not a verdict.

My take: I’m not looking for a reversal in ETH today, just an oversold bounce. The current price is 1657–1665, down about 2% over 24 hours. The daily RSI at 27 is indeed oversold, but the price is still below the 20/50/100-day EMAs, with the moving averages bearishly aligned. An oversold RSI doesn’t mean the structure has reversed.

There’s just one key level: 1603. If it holds, first watch 1706, then 1827 if that level is cleared. But even if ETH reaches 1827, I’d treat it as a relief rally, not a trend reversal. If it decisively closes below 1603 on the daily chart, watch 1518 and then 1444. In an extreme bout of panic, 1383 isn’t out of the question either, but that’s a tail risk, not my base case.

There’s a small crack in the flows picture: ETH ETFs saw $78.58 million in net inflows in a single day, ending a streak of outflows. But one day doesn’t make a trend—we need to see 2–3 consecutive days of inflows; otherwise, the defense at 1603 isn’t convincing enough.

Derivatives are the real risk: longs accounted for 77% of 24-hour liquidations, 73% of accounts are still holding longs, Binance taker flow is 62.8% bearish, and funding rates are still positive. In plain English: longs are still crowded and being forced to deleverage. The negative feedback loop of decline → liquidations → further decline isn’t over. Open interest falling 3.5% shows that the cleanup has started, but it isn’t finished. On the macro front, tariff worries and weakness in U.S. stocks were the direct catalysts for today’s drop below 1700.

My conclusion: oversold conditions are real, but don’t mistake oversold for a reversal. If 1603 holds, look for a recovery; if it breaks, don’t try to catch a falling knife. Wait for consecutive ETF inflows, open interest to stabilize, and a reclaim of the 21-day moving average before talking about a recovery.

#ETH

关键就一条线：1603。守住，先看1706，过了再看1827；但就算摸到1827，我也只当缓解性反弹，不是趋势反转。1603若日线有效跌破，1518、1444依次看，极端情绪下1383也不是不能想，但这是尾部风险，不是我的基准。

资金面有个边际裂缝：ETH ETF单日净流入7858万美元，终结连续流出，但一天不算数，得看连续2–3天，否则1603防守成色不够。

衍生品才是真风险：24h清算多头占77%，账户73%还在扛多，币安吃单62.8%偏空，资金费率还是正。翻译成人话：多头拥挤还在被强制去杠杆，下跌→清算→再下跌的负反馈没走完。持仓量降3.5%说明清理开始，但没结束。宏观上关税担忧+美股走弱是今天跌破1700的直接推手。

我的结论：超卖是事实，但别把超卖当反转。1603不破看修复，破了别接飞刀。等ETF连续流入+持仓量止跌+收复21日均线，再谈恢复。

🇬🇧 Regulatory Alert: UK Bars Crypto Exchanges From Market Making on Their Own Platforms ⚖️

The United Kingdom is ending a longstanding practice in digital asset trading by legally separating exchange operators from proprietary market makers. Following HM Treasury’s signing of the Cryptoassets Miscellaneous Amendments Regulations 2026 (SI 2026/1219) on November 18, 2026, finalized Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) rule CRYPTO 6.6.1R will prohibit qualifying cryptoasset trading platform operators from executing orders with their own capital on venues they run.

Compliance Date: The restriction takes full legal effect on October 25, 2027, alongside the UK’s broader cryptoasset regulatory regime.
Authorization Cutoff: Existing exchanges serving UK users must apply for FCA authorization by February 28, 2027, to qualify for transitional protection while under review.

Third-Party Liquidity Exemption: Under newly introduced Article 9 UA, independent third-party market makers are exempt from separate principal-dealing permissions when providing liquidity on qualifying platforms—including in spot $BTC , $ETH , and $BNB —provided venues monitor activity and disclose incentive programs.

By removing the venue operator from acting as a counterparty on its own order book, UK regulators aim to eliminate structural information advantages and align crypto markets with traditional securities rules.

content:
Thread 1: Regulatory Mechanics & Legal Structure 🏛️

#UKToBanExchangesMakingMarketsOnOwnPlatforms 🏛️ Inside the UK’s Exchange Market-Making Ban: Rules, Carve-Outs & Deadlines 📜
Under FCA rule CRYPTO 6.6.1R and guidance CRYPTO 6.6.4G, a crypto trading venue serving UK users cannot double as the most active proprietary trader on its own order book. Here is how the legal framework operates:

{future}(BTCUSDT)
{spot}(BNBUSDT)
{future}(ETHUSDT)

Eliminating Asymmetric Information: Regulators concluded that an exchange seeing customers stop levels and order depth before outside traders creates an inherent conflict of interest that risk warnings alone cannot fix.

Affiliate & Matched-Principal Rules: Platforms may still facilitate matched-principal client trades under strict risk limits, and operators can trade proprietary capital on external venues—but any affiliated entity trading on the operator's own platform must follow the exact same access rules as regular users.

Key Timeline: After HM Treasury’s November 18, 2026 statutory instrument, firms face a February 28, 2027 FCA application deadline ahead of the October 25, 2027 enforcement launch.

For major assets like $BTC , $ETH , and $BNB , the UK is enforcing the exact separation of duties that governs traditional equities.

一、价格走势分析

Don't mistake a whale's wallet size for proof of trading discipline.

An on-chain tracking post shared a sobering case: $ETH  bought in at $1,988, was once sitting on an unrealized profit of $14.19 million, but ultimately exited at a loss of $7.17 million. This is a case reported by the tracker, not a complete account ledger I've independently verified.

What's really worth unpacking is the decision-making: after the price rises, under what conditions do you take partial profits? When it falls back near your entry price, how much of your original reason for buying still holds? If the answer is always to wait for the price to recover, so-called long-term holding may just be a temporary change of tune.

Whether you're holding $BTC  or ETH, if you only calculate the upside before buying and don't plan how to exit if your thesis fails, even the prettiest profit screenshot is just one part of the process.

Just as the BTC valuation framework seemed to be changing, Wall Street struck again

New CFTC guidance: Wall Street can use BTC as collateral, but at an 80% valuation—and it can't count toward cash requirements.

We talked about this just a couple of days ago, and now there’s an update. The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) says futures trading firms can use cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin and Ethereum as collateral, but they’ll be subject to a haircut. Bitcoin and Ethereum will be valued at 80% of their market value—for example, $1 million worth of BTC would count as only $800,000. Stablecoins like USDC will be subject to a 2% haircut. A couple of days ago, this seemed like good news. Now Wall Street has dealt another blow: these cryptocurrencies can’t be used to meet a separate cash and liquidity requirement. In plain English, crypto can count as part of your “hard assets,” but it can’t serve as “ready cash.”

Impact on the market
- Short term: This news could dampen sentiment around BTC and ETH further. Regulators keep introducing new rules, which shows they still don’t trust cryptocurrencies.
- Medium term: The industry could become more divided. Institutions that need to maintain large cash reserves may still see cryptocurrencies as unreliable. Judging by the regulatory trend, full deregulation is still a long way off.

My take
This news isn’t exactly bullish or bearish; it just adds some uncertainty to the market. The key thing for BTC and ETH right now is whether they can hold the $59K and $1.65K levels. If they can’t, those earlier bullish factors may end up counting for nothing. Don’t be too hard on me if I’m wrong—I’m only trying it out with a small position.

BlackOpal’s LiquidStone II now accepts confidential deposits via Zama

BlackOpal’s LiquidStone II strategy now accepts confidential deposits, keeping each depositor’s position encrypted onchain. The privacy layer comes from Zama, and it arrives as part of a wider rollout of confidential vaults across several DeFi platforms.

What changed for LiquidStone II
The update was announced on November 18, 2026, as part of a broader Zama expansion. That rollout also brought confidential vaults to Morpho, NUVA, and Yuzu.

The first stage includes five new confidential vaults across platforms, including Plume Network’s Nest vaults. LiquidStone II is one of the headline products in that batch.
Deposits flow in as confidential $USDC, labeled cUSDC. Individual amounts and balances are encrypted onchain.

When settlements happen, they occur in batches. Outside observers see only the aggregate totals, not who put in what.

The design also allows selective disclosure for authorized parties. That means a depositor’s balance stays hidden from the public, while still being viewable by those with the right permissions, such as auditors or compliance teams.

Notably, the confidentiality layer does not change the fund’s yields or structure. Credit risk and liquidity terms stay as they were. The only thing that moves into the shadows is the individual position data.

The strategy under the hood
LiquidStone II is a tokenized private credit product. Its core exposure is FX-hedged Brazilian credit card receivables.

The strategy also keeps a Superstate $USDC liquidity sleeve and actively allocates between the receivables and that $USDC position.

The headline number is a target net APY of over 14% after fees. That is a target, not a guarantee.

The strategy offers daily redemption, with settlement periods of 1 to 5 days.

The underlying receivables are short-duration. The research findings also report zero defaults since inception in September 2025.

The total supply of DAI and USDS, the two stablecoins under the Sky platform, has suddenly fallen below $7.7 billion—down 43% from its peak in April. This has sent shockwaves through the entire DeFi community. After all, stablecoins are the bedrock of the crypto world, and a sudden, steep drop in supply is like a bank suddenly announcing it’s laying off 43% of its staff—it’s bound to make people nervous.

The root cause isn’t a technical failure; it’s the rapidly fading trust in the Sky platform. A drop in stablecoin supply usually points to one of two things: either users are rushing to redeem their tokens, or the platform is actively burning them. Sky’s situation looks more like the latter—they may have realized they can’t keep going and have begun deliberately scaling back their operations. What does this mean? It means cracks are appearing in the trust mechanism at the heart of the DeFi system—and this is happening just as BTC and ETH are both taking a beating, making matters even worse.

Impact on the Market
The main impact on BTC and ETH is likely to be psychological. ETH is currently falling harder than BTC, and news of this supply drop could make people wonder: if even stablecoins are in trouble, will other cryptocurrencies be next? In the short term, this news could heighten risk aversion, with funds potentially flowing out of high-risk DeFi projects and into relatively safer assets like Bitcoin. But over the long term, if this crisis of confidence spreads, the entire crypto market could face the risk of a crash. A historical parallel? The 2008 financial crisis was an example of trust collapsing in the banking system—only this time, the stage is blockchain.

💡 In my view, this could limit the short-term rebound potential of BTC and ETH, since problems in DeFi can trigger a chain reaction of panic. But how far prices might fall depends on whether regulators step in right away. If the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission really does get involved this time, the downside could be limited.

Sky平台旗下的DAI和USDS这两种稳定币的总供应量突然跌破了77亿美元，相比4月份的最高点缩水了43%。这事儿直接让整个DeFi圈炸开了锅，毕竟稳定币是加密世界的基石，供应量突然大幅下降，就像银行突然宣布要裁员43%一样，让人心里直打鼓。

这事根本原因不在于技术故障，而在于市场对Sky平台的信任正在快速流失。你看，稳定币供应量下降通常有两种可能：要么是用户在疯狂赎回，要么是平台在主动销毁代币。但Sky这次的情况更像是后者——他们可能意识到自己撑不住了，开始主动收缩业务。这背后意味着什么？意味着DeFi系统最关键的信任机制正在出现裂痕，而且是在当前BTC和ETH都跌得够呛的时候，这简直是在雪上加霜。

Over the past two weeks,
I used a small account with 249.69U to test live trading,
and grew it to 1,528.09U in 13 days—a 6.1x return 📈

A lot of people have guessed that I caught a coin that surged a hundredfold,
but there was nothing magical about the process.
It was even so “boring” that it went against human nature.

Steadily growing a small account isn’t about luck.
It comes down to the 3 habits I stuck to over these 13 days:

1️⃣ Set aside part of your capital for peace of mind; never stubbornly hold on to a loss
I refuse to go all in.
I always keep a reserve to help me stay level-headed.
If I get the direction wrong, I cut my losses decisively—never blindly average down.
I only hold a position and let profits run
when I’ve correctly identified the trend structure.

2️⃣ I’d rather sit on the sidelines and have tea than fidget and make trades
When the market is moving sideways with no clear direction, I close the app and get on with life.
The biggest risk for a small account isn’t missing out;
it’s opening trades all the time,
letting fees, slippage, and emotion-driven stop-losses eat away at your capital.
If price hasn’t reached a key structural level, I won’t chase it—even if a huge green candle shoots sky-high.

3️⃣ Take profits off the table first, and play defense on weekends
Once I reach an interim target, I lock in some of the profits.
I don’t get overconfident and increase my position just because the account has grown.
On weekends, when liquidity is low, I proactively reduce my positions and play defense.
My total P&L for the day was only -0.96U (-0.07%).
I never give back on a choppy market what I earned during the week.

Growing a small account
has never depended on one brilliant trade.
It’s about “knowing when to act,
and, more importantly, knowing when to hold back.”

Having little capital isn’t scary.
The real danger is getting carried away and knocking yourself out of the game
before an opportunity even comes along.

很多人猜是不是抓到了百倍暴漲幣，
但其實過程一點都不神奇，
甚至「無聊」到有點反人性。

小資金能穩穩滾起來，靠的不是運氣，
而是我這 13 天死守的 3 個習慣：

1️⃣ 本金切開留底氣，虧損絕不硬扛
拒絕一把梭哈，
永遠留一筆備用底氣穩住心態。
看錯方向就果斷認賠，絕不盲目補倉；
唯有抓對趨勢結構時，
才敢拿住單子讓利潤奔跑。

2️⃣ 寧可空倉喝茶，也不手癢折騰
橫盤沒方向時直接關軟體去過生活。
小資金最怕的不是踏空，
而是每天頻繁開單，
被手續費、滑點和情緒化止損磨光本金。
沒到關鍵結構位置，大陽線拉上天也不追。

3️⃣ 盈利先抽身，週末懂防守
達成階段目標後先把部分利潤落袋，
不因為帳戶變大就膨脹加倉。
到了流動性差的週末，我主動降倉防守，
整天盈虧僅 -0.96U（-0.07%），
絕不在震盪盤把平日賺的錢吐回去。

小資金想做起來，
靠的從來不是某一次神操作，
而是「知道什麼時候該出手，
更知道什麼時候該管住手」。

本金少不可怕，
最怕還沒等到機會，
就先因為上頭把自己玩出局了。

晚上直播間繼續帶大家拆解盤面結構，
想跟上實戰節奏的歡迎來聊聊！💜

subTitle:
量子还没来敲门，以太坊基金会先把一件更近的事排到了最前面：AI。

11月23日官方系列PQAI的开篇写得很干脆。量子威胁他们已经规划了好几年，但最近AI成了「更紧迫的风险」——模型已经在生产软件里找漏洞，速度比人审得快，也开始改进用了几十年的算法。基金会同时划了界：这并不等于AI马上就能打穿密码学假设，只是他们不愿在风险管理上干等。

translatedData.title: “AI is more urgent”: The Ethereum Foundation doubles its protocol security team
translatedData.subTitle:
Quantum hasn’t come knocking yet, but the Ethereum Foundation has moved something closer at hand to the top of its list: AI.

The opening post in the official PQAI series on November 23 was blunt. They have been planning for the quantum threat for years, but recently AI has become “the more urgent risk”—models are already finding bugs in production software faster than human reviewers can, and are beginning to improve algorithms that have been used for decades. The Foundation also drew a line: this does not mean AI can immediately break cryptographic assumptions; they simply do not want to sit idle when it comes to risk management.

The actions are also very concrete. Consensus-layer validators will switch to hash-based keys, wallets will give users a path to migrate to hash-based signatures, and blobs will use hash commitments. To keep formal verification and security testing in step with development, the Foundation doubled the size of its protocol security team and made this its top priority. The internal timeline is still 2029, with progress to be reviewed again in January; at Devcon, Justin Drake mentioned a December 2028 target, while Ethlabs has a more aggressive PQAI27 plan. These are all still targets; the locks have not all been changed yet.

A publicly listed company sells ETH to repay debt｜BTCS’s 8-K confirms it｜I’ll wait for leverage risks to ease before considering a position

My stance remains defensive. When I see a company selling crypto, I first want to know “why it’s selling and when.” In an 8-K filed on November 23, U.S.-listed BTCS stated that it sold about 27,300 ETH on November 20, receiving approximately $43.8 million, which it used to repay an Aave loan of the same amount. It still had about $10.5 million in Aave debt after repayment. This is a completed transaction disclosed by the company to the SEC—not a hint on social media, nor a new sale that took place today. The company’s press release added that, based on an ETH price of about $1,722 on November 22, it held approximately 24,245 ETH after the sale and debt repayment. These figures for assets and debt are preliminary, unaudited estimates and should not be treated as real-time balances.

What I’m focused on is not just the number of ETH sold, but the leverage chain. When a company uses ETH as collateral to borrow, a fall in the coin’s price reduces the value of its collateral. If it maintains its debt, the risk of liquidation increases. Selling coins to repay debt voluntarily lowers leverage and reduces the chance of forced liquidation later. But the sale itself adds spot supply during a downturn, and other highly leveraged holders may reassess their risk as a result. BTCS’s disclosure only shows that this company is deleveraging; it doesn’t mean all ETH treasury companies will follow suit, much less that the entire market decline can be attributed to BTCS. The company says the loan-to-value ratio for its remaining Aave borrowing is about 32%. That is based on the company’s own disclosure and doesn’t mean there is no longer any risk in on-chain lending systems.

Fund-flow data also offers no sign of a reversal. Farside currently lists net outflows of $84.9 million from U.S. spot ETH funds on November 23 and $64.1 million on November 24. Although the outflow narrowed the following day, the two-day total was still about $149 million. At 13:42 Beijing time, ETH/USDT on Binance was around $1,654, with a 24-hour range of approximately $1,649 to $1,710, leaving the price near the low end. Market performance is consistent with a risk-off environment, but simultaneous moves don’t prove that corporate deleveraging directly caused the current price. A trending topic on Binance Square is the Ethereum Foundation’s post-quantum roadmap, which is about long-term technical development; I won’t conflate it with this corporate balance-sheet disclosure and treat it as a short-term reason to buy. Later, revised U.S. GDP figures and personal income and spending data could also trigger more volatility in risk assets.

If I were trading myself, I wouldn’t enter now or short. I’d only keep a conditional spot long setup in mind: ETH must first close a four-hour candle back above $1,690, then hold the $1,680–$1,690 zone on a retest, while BTC stabilizes and fund outflows don’t start widening again. Only then would I buy ETH with no more than 0.7% of my total capital, without leverage. The first target is $1,715, where I’d halve the position; the second is $1,745, where I’d exit the rest in stages. The initial stop is $1,640. If ETH breaks below $1,645 before entry, I’ll cancel the plan. After entry, I’ll close early if ETH falls back below $1,680 on another four-hour candle or if a new disclosure formally shows that a publicly listed company has been forced to sell coins. If none of these conditions trigger, I’ll remain on the sidelines and won’t mistake watching the market for making a trade.

Next, I’ll check the company’s subsequent SEC filings, whether the fund-flow breakdowns are revised, and whether ETH can regain and hold above $1,690. Lower leverage can help reduce tail risk, but whether the price has bottomed still needs to be confirmed independently. #ETH

This is only my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

上市公司卖ETH还债｜BTCS的8-K已确认｜我等杠杆风险消化再考虑参与

我的态度是继续防守，看到企业卖币也先问清“为什么卖、什么时候卖”。美国上市公司BTCS在11月23日提交的8-K写明，11月20日出售约27300枚ETH，取得约4380万美元，用于偿还同额Aave借款，偿还后仍有约1050万美元Aave债务。这是公司向SEC披露的已发生交易，不是社交媒体暗示，也不是今天又发生一笔新卖单。公司新闻稿补充称，按11月22日ETH约1722美元估值，出售还债后约持有24245枚ETH；这些资产和债务数字是初步、未经审计的估计，不能当作此刻实时余额。

我关注的重点不只是27300枚的数量，而是杠杆链条。企业用ETH做抵押借贷，币价下跌时抵押品价值降低，若继续维持债务，清算风险会增加。主动卖币还款降低负债率，也减少之后被动清算的可能；但出售本身会在下跌期增加现货供给，其他高杠杆持仓者可能因此重新评估风险。BTCS披露的行动只能证明这家公司去杠杆，不能推断所有ETH财库公司都会跟卖，更不能把整个市场下跌完全归因于它。公司称剩余Aave借款对应的贷款价值比约32%，这是其披露口径，不代表链上借贷系统已经没有风险。

资金数据也没有给出反转信号。Farside现列11月23日美国现货ETH基金净流出8490万美元，11月24日净流出6410万美元，后一天流出幅度虽收窄，两日合计仍约1.49亿美元。北京时间13时42分，币安ETH/USDT约1654美元，24小时区间约1649至1710美元，价格仍靠近低位。市场表现与去风险环境相符，但不能从同向变动证明企业减仓直接造成当前价格。广场热门话题里有以太坊基金会抗量子路线，那是长期技术研发；我不会把它与这份企业资产负债表公告混成一个短线买入理由。晚些时候美国GDP修订与个人收入支出数据公布，也可能让风险资产再波动。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与，不做空，只保留条件明确的现货试多：ETH先四小时收回1690美元，回踩1680至1690区间守住，同时BTC止跌、基金流出没有重新放大，我才用总资金最多0.7%买入ETH，不加杠杆。第一目标1715美元，触及减半；第二目标1745美元，余仓分批减完。初始止损1640美元，若入场前先跌破1645美元，取消计划；入场后若四小时再次跌回1680下方，或出现新的上市公司被迫卖币正式披露，我会提前平仓。没有触发就继续空仓，不把观察写成成交。

接下来核对公司后续SEC文件、基金分项是否修订、ETH能否重新站稳1690。杠杆下降有助于减轻尾部风险，但价格是否筑底仍需要独立确认。#ETH

以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。

Ethereum Foundation says its quantum-safe overhaul is tougher than the Merge

Moving Ethereum to quantum-resistant cryptography is more difficult than the 2022 Merge, according to the Ethereum Foundation.

Additionally, it has less time to finish because AI, not quantum hardware, now controls the speed.

The plan, which is the first in a series the foundation refers to as PQAI, short for post-quantum and post-AI, was outlined by Kev Wedderburn in a post on November 23. “This upgrade is harder than the Merge, and we have less time,” he wrote.
On Sept. 15, 2022, the Merge modified Ethereum’s consensus engine while the chain continued to function. No downtime, no money lost after years of shadow forks and devnets.

There are preliminary specifications. The first post-quantum consensus-layer devnet, pq-cl, is being refined by developers.

BLS and ECDSA give way to hash-based signatures
There are three layers to the revamp. Elliptic curves are no longer necessary for finality because validators sign using hash-based keys.

Wallets can switch to hash-based signatures for user accounts.

The blobs, data packets that rollups send to Ethereum, are converted to hash-based commitments.

Currently, Ethereum employs ECDSA for user accounts and BLS signatures for validators. Both could be cracked by a big enough quantum computer.

After more than a year of testing candidate signature schemes, the Foundation decided to use hash-based cryptography. The adjustment doesn’t add any new assumptions because Ethereum already trusts its hash functions, Wedderburn wrote.

In order to prevent quick work from shipping flaws, the foundation doubled the size of its protocol security team. Formal verification and security efforts must keep up with the development of protocols.#Write2Earn #ETH $ETH

News about tariffs overseas dragged Nasdaq futures lower, with semiconductors leading the plunge. The four-hour chart for $SOXLB  looked like it was riding a vertical elevator down: it plunged 29.67% in 24 hours, dropping from $43.53 all the way to $30.20, with trading volume climbing to $83.65 million. The most nerve-racking part? Just a few days ago, it bounced off a previous low of $29.86, but before that rebound had even had time to settle, it was shoved right back to square one. Its 24-hour low has already touched $29.91. Anyone watching that line hover around the $30 mark would have sweaty palms. Nearby, $NVDAB  also fell more than 7%, retreating to $151.92, with over $50 million changing hands in a day. Even the inverse token was up more than 30%—today, all the money was crowded into the semiconductor trade.

Looking back at $ETH , it was trading at $1,657, down 2.95%, with $455 million in trading volume. Compared with semiconductors, it seemed downright “gentle.” Still, its four-hour chart has slipped back below the moving averages, giving back nearly all of the rebound from the past couple of days. On days like this, don’t rush to catch a falling knife. Keep your hands off, watch more, trade less, and DYOR.
